title: AgentCloneRecord
description: A clone and how it currently resolves. Revision increments on every change to the document or the synced version.

resolvedVersion.description: The template version the clone uses now; absent when it cannot resolve.

upstreamVersion.description: The template's published version, when it differs from resolvedVersion.

assignable.description: Whether joiners can get this clone: its resolved version is the published one.

reason.description: Why the clone is not assignable, or is behind upstream.
